svt_mipi_dsi_burst_with_sync_event_skew_sequence Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This sequence creates a scenerio for Video Frame in Sync Event, burst mode. Sequence length represents number of Frames. User Control: The user can control sequence length, HBP/HFP period and VC ID. Low power mode during BLLP period can be achieved by setting the flag bllp_low_power.
